target.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, 'Fleet rollout ' || status AS text, 'rollout' AS tags FROM grafana_fleet_rollouts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 200

SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, 'Edge artifact published: ' || kind AS text, 'artifact' AS tags FROM grafana_edge_artifacts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, kind ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200
SELECT created_at AS time, 'Cache purge ' || type AS text, 'purge' AS tags FROM grafana_cache_purges WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 200

SELECT created_at AS time, action AS text, 'settings' AS tags FROM grafana_audit_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (action LIKE 'settings.%' OR action LIKE 'platform.%') ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 200
SELECT created_at AS time, 'Emergency mode on for ' || target_type AS text, 'emergency' AS tags FROM grafana_emergency_modes WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 200

panels.description: The selected hostnames with requests, errors, cache hit, bytes, and latency, for support to compare.

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT hostname, sum(requests) AS request_count, 100 * sumIf(requests, status >= 500) / nullIf(sum(requests), 0) AS error_percent, 100 * sumIf(requests, cache_status = 'HIT') / nullIf(sum(requests), 0) AS hit_percent, sum(bytes_sent) AS bytes, quantilesTDigestMerge(0.5, 0.95, 0.99)(edge_latency_q)[2] AS p95_ms FROM cdnf.edge_traffic_hourly WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND interval_start <= $__toTime AND dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime) BETWEEN 0 AND 34560000 AND $__conditionalAll(region IN (${region:singlequote}), $region) AND $__conditionalAll(pop IN (${pop:singlequote}), $pop) AND $__conditionalAll(edge_id IN (${edge:singlequote}), $edge) AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) AND $__conditionalAll(hostname IN (${hostname:singlequote}), $hostname) GROUP BY hostname UNION ALL SELECT hostname, sum(requests) AS request_count, 100 * sumIf(requests, status >= 500) / nullIf(sum(requests), 0) AS error_percent, 100 * sumIf(requests, cache_status = 'HIT') / nullIf(sum(requests), 0) AS hit_percent, sum(bytes_sent) AS bytes, quantilesTDigestMerge(0.5, 0.95, 0.99)(edge_latency_q)[2] AS p95_ms FROM cdnf.edge_traffic_daily WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime) AND interval_start <= $__toTime AND dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime) BETWEEN 34560001 AND 10000000000 AND $__conditionalAll(region IN (${region:singlequote}), $region) AND $__conditionalAll(pop IN (${pop:singlequote}), $pop) AND $__conditionalAll(edge_id IN (${edge:singlequote}), $edge) AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) AND $__conditionalAll(hostname IN (${hostname:singlequote}), $hostname) GROUP BY hostname) ORDER BY request_count DESC LIMIT 30
